subject: Aurora Tech pilot kickoff — scope, success metrics, and onboarding steps
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@auroratech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora Tech pilot kickoff — scope, success metrics, and onboarding steps

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before kickoff: 

Key pain points you called out:
- Search relevance for product docs and knowledge base (low click-through on top results)
- Latency spikes for embedding lookups during peak traffic windows
- Cost sensitivity on embedding generation and storage for long-term sessions

Pilot goals / success metrics (proposed):
- Improve relevant-result precision (P@5) by >= 20% on the provided prompt sample set
- Average embedding lookup latency < 200ms (99th percentile) for the test workload
- Verify unit cost for embeddings and generation meets Aurora internal threshold (target: < $12 per 1M embedding ops)

Scope (4-week POC):
- Models: evaluate two open variants (1 dense LLM for rerank + 1 embedder quantized)
- Prompt set: ~200 representative queries from Aurora (we’ll use the initial CSV you shared and expand to 200)
- Evaluation: automated eval harness + manual spot-checks; baseline vs. current system
- Integration: temporary API keys for test GCP project; allowlisted egress from Aurora IPs

Owners:
- Aurora: Samir Gupta (product lead) and procurement@auroratech.com (procurement)
- Redwood: Diego Fernandez (AM/owner), Marissa Cole (SE — evals & prompt mapping), Priyom Das (infra — capacity & routing)

Immediate asks from Redwood to Aurora:
1) Confirm procurement contact and PO cadence (or DocuSign path)
2) Share final prompt sample CSV (we’ll expand to 200 prompts) — drop in the shared Drive link below
3) Provide GCP project ID or temporary VM for initial traffic replay + IP allowlist CIDR

Access/setup steps (what we’ll provide this week):
- Pilot scope doc (attached: aurora_poc_scope_v1.pdf)
- Shared Drive folder with prompt CSV and runbook (redwood_pilot_runbook.md)
- Temporary API key + minimal RBAC token for test project (will send once GCP project is shared)

Proposed kickoff window: week of Mar 16 — we can set a 45-min alignment call to walk through runbook and assign access.

If that all looks good, please reply with confirmation and the procurement contact. Once we have procurement and the GCP project ID, SE/infra will start provisioning.

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0126

Attachments: aurora_poc_scope_v1.pdf
From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@auroratech.com>

Cc: Aurora Tech Procurement <procurement@auroratech.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Tech pilot kickoff — scope, success metrics, and onboarding steps

Diego — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the high level looks right to us. A few notes: 

- Procurement contact is procurement@auroratech.com (CC’d) — they’ll handle the SOW/PO.
- Kickoff week of Mar 16 works; can we target Tue Mar 17 at 10:00 AM PT for the alignment call?
- We’ll share the prompt sample CSV by end of day Monday (Mar 16) — it currently has ~85 queries; we’ll flag which product areas to prioritize.
- On security: can you attach your SOC 2 attestation and confirm whether logs for the pilot will be stored in our GCP project or Redwood-managed storage? We have an internal requirement to avoid sending PII to third-party storage without a signed DPA.

Also, we’ll need a short 1-page summary of expected costs for the pilot (rough monthlyized estimate) to share with finance.

On the API keys: we prefer Redwood to create a scoped key and send it to our engineering lead via the secure link you provide.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

—Samir
Samir Gupta
Senior Product Manager, Search
Aurora Tech
samir.gupta@auroratech.com
